intro_add: NovoTech's value-line notchers, built in China, add the PTN-30 hole-saw notcher, the UTN40 end-mill notchers, drill-press and hand notchers and the PRS tube end grinders that notch tube from Ø3/4 to 5-3/4″ with a belt.
points_add: NovoTech value line: PTN-30 hole-saw notcher, UTN40 end-mill notchers, PRS belt tube-end grinders to Ø5-3/4″

faq_add.q: Hole saw, end mill or belt — which notching method?
faq_add.a: A hole-saw notcher (PTN-30, PNM 1-1/2) is the lowest-cost way to cut a saddle: one inexpensive bi-metal hole saw per tube size, any angle, clean enough for most welding. An end-mill notcher (UTN40) cuts faster and more precisely, without coolant, and one cutter covers several sizes. A belt notcher (PRS) grinds the saddle against a contact roller: no burr, no sharp tooling, works on thin-wall stainless and aluminum and also finishes and deburrs. The premium-line PN machines are motorized notchers for production.
